title: Kagamine Len — Brand New Street〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Alright! I did well on that part that was giving me trouble yesterday!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Oh, and Rin's doing better on the part she was struggling with too! In fact, she put a nice little spin on it!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Alright, here I go!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Phew...! We had another great practice today! That spin you threw in was nice too!
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But you were awesome too, Len!
You matched me right away.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's 'cause I'm your partner!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder if Kohane and the others are practicing in their world right about now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They probably are, don't you think?
They've got practice with An's dad and all that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len...? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Our practice went really great just now, but...
I was just thinking about whether this is enough...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, Kohane and the others have An's dad, one of the people behind that legendary night, helping with their practices.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It sounded intense just from what we heard the other day! I bet they've got an incredible practice going on right now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-An incredible practice?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So! Don't you think we'll get left behind if we don't do something incredible too?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You might be right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What do we do?!
I can't think of any way to have an incredible practice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay!
These are the times when we just need to go and ask!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, an incredible practice...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We don't wanna get left behind Kohane and the others! So tell us some incredible practice we can do!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm...
Incredible practice, eh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shouldn't it be fine? I don't think you need to do anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO! Don't joke around!
We're serious about this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, what she said!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Owww!
W-Wait...! Hear me out too, guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sorry, my bad.
I shouldn't have started with the conclusion like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First off, what was it that made you want to do some incredible practice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like we already said, we figure Kohane and the others must be doing that sort of practice with An's dad.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Uh-huh. And so, you felt that you didn't want to get left behind, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmmm, so that's the part I don't really get...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What makes you think you're going to get left behind if you don't do some incredible practice?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I-I mean...
Since Kohane and the others are doing some incredible stuff, I figured...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Practice is supposed to be for learning to do things you can't do, and improving at the things you can, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Kohane and the others have things they should be learning and improving on...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And so do the two of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But if you don't know what those things are yourselves, don't you think whatever practice you end up doing will be useless?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right... I kinda thought doing some crazy practice would make us improve, but that's the wrong way to look at it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What is it that you can do, and what is it that you're lacking...
It'll be better if you can focus on thinking about those things first.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you feel like it'll be tough to think that through on your own, I'll help you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You will?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y'know, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sometimes you feel like a real teacher!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, that's 'cause I am your teacher!
